text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp has finally come to an
end...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It looks like we got through without a
hitch.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. We're ready for the Shuka Sho.
Let's keep
up this pace once we're back.
choice_data_list: We got plenty of special training in, too.
We got plenty of special training in, too, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Student Council Member
text_block_list.text:
Vice President! Some students aren't
here for roll
call!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What?! Why must they make things
difficult right
until the last minute?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although Air Groove seemed busy from
start to
finish, it was definitely a
productive summer
camp!
